walkthrough: Goal: put a first line on the canvas with the pen.
Entry: open the app on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape). A dark top bar reads OpenPaint; below it the whole screen is a white canvas.
Gesture: draw a curve with the pen, light at the start, pressing harder, then easing off.
What appears: a black line follows the tip, thin where the pen is light and up to 12 px where it presses; lifting leaves it there.
A finger dragged across the canvas, or a finger tap, draws nothing: only the pen paints (since S14 the drag moves the canvas).
Not yet: undo (S6) and reopening with the line still there (S7).
